title: Committee of Supply – Head R (Ministry of Law)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head R (Ministry of Law)

sections.label: Budget cut for Head R
sections.summary: A motion proposes reducing the total sum allocated for Head R of the Estimates by $100.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I beg to move, "That the total sum to be allocated for Head R of the Estimates be reduced by $100".

sections.label: MinLaw legal hub promotion
sections.summary: It asks what measures MinLaw will take to bolster Singapore's legal hub reputation and promote Singapore Law for agreements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: What measures will the Ministry of Law (MinLaw) undertake to further bolster Singapore’s reputation as a regional and global legal hub?

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: How will MinLaw help to promote Singapore Law as the law of choice governing domestic, international and cross-border agreements at the time the parties sign those agreements?

sections.label: Low bono legal aid framework
sections.summary: It asks if MinLaw will consider a framework supporting low bono efforts, noting arbitration clauses in consumer contracts.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: Bearing this in mind and considering the need to close some gaps, we may, therefore, want to cast our sights on a more sustainable solution which could be a win-win solution for all.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: I would, therefore, like to ask if MinLaw would consider developing a framework to support low bono efforts by lawyers to augment existing legal aid schemes?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen Show Mao (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Increasingly, in some standard form mass market consumer contracts that ordinary Singaporeans enter into without much room for negotiation, such as some insurance policies, there are contractual requirements that the parties go to arbitration in the event of a dispute.

sections.label: Arbitration clauses and POHA data
sections.summary: It notes arbitration clauses may block needy claimants from Legal Aid and asks for POHA case updates and breakdowns.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen Show Mao (Aljunied)
sentences.text: So, there are many good reasons why an insurance company that drafts the policy would want such an arbitration clause.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen Show Mao (Aljunied)
sentences.text: But one effect of such a clause is that it may keep a needy Singaporean from pressing a meritorious claim in the event of a dispute, since Legal Aid currently does not cover the costs of arbitration proceedings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: Since coming into force in November 2014, can MinLaw provide an update on the number of cases filed, mediated and heard on an annual basis from 2014 to 2018 under the Protection from Harassment Act (POHA)?

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: Among all POHA cases filed, what is the breakdown of the type of cases, for example, how many involved community, neighbours; how many are online harassment, how many are sexual harassment cases and how many are workplace harassment cases?

sections.label: Public Trustee small intestate estates
sections.summary: It states the Public Trustee can administer intestate estates under $50,000 without a Court application.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: As Members would know, currently, if the value of the estate of a person who died intestate is less than $50,000, the Public Trustee is able to administer the estate without the need for the family to make a Court application.

sections.label: SICC International Judges
sections.summary: It states the SICC has 16 International Judges in addition to experienced Supreme Court judges.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: SICC currently has, in addition to our own experienced Supreme Court judges, 16 International Judges, who are also highly regarded jurists in their own jurisdictions.

sections.label: Hague Convention and SICC judgments
sections.summary: Singapore acceded to the Hague Convention on Choice of Court Agreements, allowing SICC judgments to be enforced in contracting parties' jurisdictions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: In addition, Singapore acceded to the Hague Convention on Choice of Court Agreements which allows SICC judgments to be enforced in jurisdictions of the contracting parties, thereby broadening the reach of SICC judgments.

sections.label: Chief Justice on legal technology
sections.summary: The Chief Justice said the profession's response to legal technology was lukewarm, citing a 2017 study finding 9% of small and medium law practices used productivity tools.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: At the Singapore Academy of Law Annual Lecture last year, the Chief Justice commented that the profession’s response to legal technology has been lukewarm.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: He highlighted a 2017 study by the Law Society which found that only 9% of small and medium-sized law practices used technology-enabled productivity tools.

sections.label: Legal paraprofessionals' pay and career issues
sections.summary: At an NTUC and Singapore Academy of Law roundtable, paraprofessionals shared pay limitations, career bottlenecks and employers not fully appreciating their potential.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
sentences.text: At the recent roundtable discussion with legal paraprofessionals jointly organised by the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC) and the Singapore Academy of Law, paraprofessionals shared that they faced pay limitations and career bottlenecks and encountered employers who were not able to fully appreciate the potential of paraprofessionals.

sections.label: Regional arbitration and infrastructure disputes
sections.summary: International arbitration is a key area of regional opportunities, and a new Singapore infrastructure dispute management protocol was introduced in October last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
sentences.text: International arbitration where parties are often cross-bordered is one key area of regional opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
sentences.text: Also, in October last year, a new Singapore infrastructure dispute management protocol was introduced to help mega infrastructure projects around the region manage disputes and minimise the risks of time and cost overruns.

sections.label: IPOS support for FinTech startups
sections.summary: A question asks whether IPOS can extend and expand funding and support for local FinTech startups and provide a one-stop IP protection service.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
sentences.text: Can the Intellectual Property Office of Singapore (IPOS) consider extending and expanding the current funding and support mechanism for our local FinTech startups and provide a one-stop service to educate, advise and handhold our startups on this IP protection journey?

sections.label: Copyright protection for creative freelancers
sections.summary: A question asks whether MinLaw can explore strengthening the copyright regime to better protect creative freelancers' ideas and works.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
sentences.text: Speaking on behalf of the thousands of professional freelancers in the creative sector, from photographers to actors, actresses, scriptwriters, graphic designers or creative directors, can MinLaw explore to see how the copyright regime can be further strengthened to better protect the creative ideas and works of these many creative freelancers?

sections.label: IP use and commercialisation
sections.summary: The passage asks how Singapore businesses use IP, what measures help them commercialise it, and what IP careers exist.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
sentences.text: How are Singapore businesses identifying and using IP to grow and expand their businesses and have they been successful?

sentences.speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
sentences.text: What measures are in place to assist Singapore businesses in commercialising their IP?

sentences.speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
sentences.text: The Committee on the Future Economy has identified IP as a key driver of Singapore's future economic growth.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
sentences.text: With this focus on innovation, what are the job opportunities and careers for Singaporeans in IP?

sections.label: Criminal Procedure Code amendments
sections.summary: Extensive amendments to the Criminal Procedure Code and Evidence Act were passed last year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: On criminal justice, we passed extensive amendments to the Criminal Procedure Code and Evidence Act last year.

sections.label: Protection Order applications filed
sections.summary: As at 31 December 2018, 535 Protection Order applications were filed, with 213 Protection Orders and 193 Expedited Protection Orders granted.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: As at 31 December 2018, 535 applications for Protection Orders have been filed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Of these, 213 Protection Orders and 193 Expedited Protection Orders were granted.

sections.label: POHA criminal cases commenced
sections.summary: The Attorney-General's Chambers commenced 1,714 criminal cases with POHA charges.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: One thousand seven hundred and fourteen criminal cases with POHA charges have also been commenced by the Attorney-General’s Chambers.

sections.label: Beta version release date
sections.summary: A beta version will be released by the end of 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: A beta version will be released by the end of 2019.

sections.label: Legal aid amendments and funding
sections.summary: The Legal Aid and Advice Act was amended, and criminal legal aid cases rose to almost 1,600 in 2018 after 2015 Government funding.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We recently amended the Legal Aid and Advice Act to simplify the means test, provide greater flexibility to grant aid and also improve on the overall administration of legal aid.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: These changes will be implemented in the second half of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: On criminal legal aid, the number of accused persons assisted per year has risen after the Government introduced direct funding in 2015. the Criminal Legal Aid Scheme assisted almost 1,600 cases in 2018, almost four times the number of cases that were assisted pre-2015, before the Government funding.

sections.label: Copyright Act creator protection
sections.summary: The Copyright Act will be amended to better support creators in the digital age.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Mr Patrick Tay asked about protecting the IP rights of creators.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We will be amending the Copyright Act to better support creators in this digital age.

sections.label: FinTech patent fast track
sections.summary: IPOS introduced a FinTech Fast Track Initiative and will extend it to 25 April 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Last year, the Intellectual Property Office of Singapore (IPOS) introduced a FinTech Fast Track Initiative which accelerates the file-to-grant period of deserving FinTech patents to approximately six months, and that is in place of the usual two to four years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: IPOS will extend this initiative for a further year to 25 April 2020.

sections.label: IP clinics for businesses
sections.summary: IPOS' IP Business Clinics and Legal Clinics offer IP advice, used by about 600 businesses since 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: There are various forms of assistance already available to enterprises, in particular, SMEs and startups, on IP strategy and management: Businesses that need preliminary advice on IP strategies to support their business plans or on IP legal issues can tap on IPOS' IP Business Clinics and Legal Clinics.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: These are available to small businesses, individuals and sole proprietors, and approximately 600 businesses have availed themselves of the use of these clinics since 2015.

sections.label: IP management programmes
sections.summary: IPOS launched a Specialist Certificate in 2019 and a Master of IP and Innovation Management programme in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: For example, IPOS launched a Specialist Certificate in Intangible Asset Management in January 2019 and also collaborated with the Singapore University of Social Sciences to launch a Master of IP and Innovation Management programme in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: This year, the first batch of 14 students is expected to graduate from this programme, with another 21 expected in the next cohort.

sections.label: International dispute resolution position
sections.summary: Singapore is now the third most preferred seat of arbitration globally.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We have done well in international dispute resolution, but we will continue to build on these efforts to further enhance our position.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We are now the third most preferred seat of arbitration globally.

sections.label: SIAC caseload in 2017
sections.summary: SIAC's highest caseload was 452 cases in 2017, of which 83% were international.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: For SIAC, the highest caseload was 452 cases in 2017, of which 83% were international in nature.

sections.label: Maxwell Chambers Suites launch
sections.summary: The refurbished Maxwell Chambers Suites will launch in the third quarter of 2019, adding 120,000 square feet and tripling Maxwell Chambers' size.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The newly refurbished building located next to it, the Maxwell Chambers Suites, will be launched in the third quarter of 2019, shortly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: This will add 120,000 square feet of floor space and triple Maxwell Chambers' current size.

sections.label: Singapore Convention on Mediation
sections.summary: The Singapore Convention on Mediation will be the first UN convention named after Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: The Singapore Convention on Mediation will be the first convention under the UN auspices to be named after Singapore.

sections.label: Extradition and legal assistance treaties
sections.summary: Singapore concluded the Model ASEAN Extradition Treaty in 2018, began ASEAN Extradition Treaty and China Mutual Legal Assistance Treaty negotiations, and was asked about the Hague Apostille Convention.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: As a sign of our commitment to international cooperation to combat transnational crime, we concluded the Model ASEAN Extradition Treaty in 2018 and launched the commencement of negotiations for an ASEAN Extradition Treaty.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We also launched the commencement of negotiations on a Mutual Legal Assistance Treaty with China.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Mr Murali Pillai asked whether Singapore intends to accede to the Hague Apostille Convention.

sections.label: Consultancy for small law firms
sections.summary: The Singapore Academy of Law's FLIP launched an initiative letting small and medium law firms engage a consultant for as low as $1,500 to review workflows and advise on technology.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: On Ms Rahayu Mahzam's point about providing customised consultancy services to small and medium firms, the Singapore Academy of Law's Future Law Innovation Programme (FLIP) recently launched an initiative, where, for as low as $1,500, small and medium-sized law firms can engage a consultant to review their workflows and advise how they can better harness and adopt technology to help with the process more efficiently and perhaps more importantly for these small firms also more cost-effectively.

sections.label: Lawyers Go Global programme
sections.summary: The Lawyers Go Global programme launched in February 2018 with the Law Society and IE Singapore, and close to 60 lawyers joined three mission trips in 12 months.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Together with the Law Society of Singapore and the then-International Enterprise (IE) Singapore, we launched the Lawyers Go Global programme in February 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: In the last 12 months, close to 60 lawyers have participated in three mission trips.

sections.label: Chinese lawyers attachment and Tech Start
sections.summary: 24 lawyers from six Shaanxi firms did a month-long Singapore attachment, and under Tech Start for Law 115 law practices adopted 143 solutions with 70% funding.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Prior to this visit, 24 lawyers from six leading firms in China's Shaanxi province undertook a month-long attachment in Singapore as part of MinLaw's initiative to help Chinese lawyers better understand what Singapore has to offer as a business hub for Chinese companies as well as also to help Singapore lawyers connect with their Chinese counterparts and learn about and tap into opportunities in the Belt and Road Initiative.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Third, in the adoption of technology, we are supporting law practices to keep up to date with technology.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: So, Members might like to know that under the Tech Start for Law scheme, SLPs have been given 70% funding, 115 law practices of which 99% are small and medium-sized ones have collectively adopted 143 of such solutions.

sections.label: SkillsFuture Study Award lawyers
sections.summary: Since 2016, 78 Singaporean lawyers and in-house counsel have received the SkillsFuture Study Award for the legal sector to hone leadership skills in managing their law firms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Members might like to know that since 2016, in the context of supporting Singapore lawyers, 78 Singaporean lawyers and inhouse counsel have successfully applied for the SkillsFuture Study Award for the legal sector to hone leadership skills in management of their own law firms.

sections.label: New York State Bar support
sections.summary: From 1 April 2019, lawyers wishing to take the New York State Bar exam will also be supported through the SkillsFuture Study Award.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: From 1 April 2019, we will also be supporting lawyers who wish to take the New York State Bar exam, through the SkillsFuture Study Award as well.

sections.label: SUSS Law School mature places
sections.summary: 80% of places at the Singapore University of Social Sciences Law School are set aside for mature students, including paralegals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: To give an example, 80% of places in the Singapore University of Social Sciences Law School are set aside for mature students, including paralegals.

sections.label: Mediation with parties' consent
sections.summary: With the consent of the parties and the mediators, that can be considered.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: With the consent of the parties, obviously, and the mediators, that can be considered.

sections.label: Upskilling for practising legal professionals
sections.summary: Those already in practice as lawyers, paralegals or support professionals must have ample opportunity to upskill, with SkillsFuture and the Academy of Law providing a broader mix of supported opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: On top of that, those who are already in practice, either as lawyers or those who are now serving a legal fraternity as paralegals or other support professionals, there must be ample opportunity to upskill.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: We are very glad to be working with SkillsFuture and the Academy of Law as well, in having a broader and more diverse mix of opportunities available and supported by SkillsFuture, so that these individuals who are already in the system can upskill themselves and enhance their career opportunities and, overall, lend to the improvement of the legal landscape that we have.
